description: 中间跳马捉后，将军后hxg3赢回
explanation_en: White's queen is loose, but Ng4 attacks Black's queen and prepares a check. After Black captures the queen, the knight's check forces a response and White's h-pawn recaptures the black queen.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：白后g3是挂子，黑后想吃。白方不应对，先Ng4！中间跳马同时攻击Qg3——黑后吃后被将军！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermezzo: White's queen on g3 is loose and Black threatens to take it. White plays Ng4 first, attacking Black's queen and preparing a check if Black captures.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Ng4中间跳！黑后吃g3，Nxf6+将军，hxg3吃回——净多一马！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Ng4 is the intermezzo. If Black takes the queen, Nxf6+ forces a response and hxg3 recaptures Black's queen, leaving White a knight ahead.

moves.popup: 白马Ng4！中间跳——攻击黑后Qg3，同时Nxf6+将军路线已准备好！
moves.popup_en: White plays Ng4 as an intermezzo, attacking Black's queen on g3 and preparing the checking move Nxf6+.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxg3——吃下白后，但Nxf6+将军已在等待！
moves.popup_en: Black captures White's queen on g3, but Nxf6+ is ready with check.

moves.popup: 白马Nxf6+！将军！黑方必须应将，无法逃跑！
moves.popup_en: White's knight captures on f6 with check. Black must answer the check and cannot move the queen to safety.
Black's g-pawn recaptures on f6 to answer the check.

moves.popup: 白兵hxg3！吃回黑后——中间招完成：净得一马，大优！
moves.popup_en: White's h-pawn captures the black queen on g3. The intermezzo wins a knight and leaves White with a large advantage.
